expires.description: Expires is when this resource expires (RFC3339).

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs attached to the resource.

namespace.description: Namespace is the resource namespace (usually left blank).

revision.description: Revision is used for optimistic concurrency control.

spec.description: AccessMonitoringRule resource definition v1 from Teleport

automatic_review.description: automatic_review defines automatic review configurations for Access Requests. Both notification and automatic_review may be set within the same access_monitoring_rule. If both fields are set, the rule will trigger both notifications and automatic reviews for the same set of access events. Separate plugins may be used if both notifications and automatic_reviews is set.

decision.description: decision specifies the proposed state of the access review. This can be either 'APPROVED' or 'DENIED'.

integration.description: integration is the name of the integration that is responsible for monitoring the rule. Set this value to `builtin` to monitor the rule with Teleport.

condition.description: condition is a predicate expression that operates on the specified subject resources, and determines whether the subject will be moved into desired state.

desired_state.description: desired_state defines the desired state of the subject. For Access Request subjects, the desired_state may be set to `reviewed` to indicate that the Access Request should be automatically reviewed.

notification.description: notification defines the plugin configuration for notifications if rule is triggered. Both notification and automatic_review may be set within the same access_monitoring_rule. If both fields are set, the rule will trigger both notifications and automatic reviews for the same set of access events. Separate plugins may be used if both notifications and automatic_reviews is set.

name.description: name is the name of the plugin to which this configuration should apply.

recipients.description: recipients is the list of recipients the plugin should notify.

schedules.description: schedules specifies a map of schedules that can be used to configure the access monitoring rule conditions.

shifts.description: Shifts contains a set of shifts that make up the schedule.

timezone.description: Timezone specifies the schedule timezone. This field is optional and defaults to "UTC". Accepted values use timezone locations as defined in the IANA Time Zone Database, such as "America/Los_Angeles", "Europe/Lisbon", or "Asia/Singapore".  See https://data.iana.org/time-zones/tzdb/zone1970.tab for a list of supported values.

states.description: states are the desired state which the monitoring rule is attempting to bring the subjects matching the condition to.

subjects.description: subjects the rule operates on, can be a resource kind or a particular resource property.
